reviews.text:
This was my vet clinic for the last four years but I'll probably start looking for a different one.

My dog's getting old so I've had to take him in more often. I came for a urinalysis and culture test last time but they couldn't do it. That was the priority for the visit. Thankfully my dog's urine leaking resolved on its own but completing the urine tests would have given me more peace of mind. A failed exam means a followup visit which requires more money since you're charged each time for the exam.

If you have a specific request in what needs to be done for your dog you should make it clear it's the priority. I learned my lesson in not making it clear enough.

Somehow his medications always seem to expire fast here too. Then I have to re do the exam each time. Mainly the heartworm one.

I'll be sad to switch since they've been pretty good at keeping my dog healthy but the little frustrations and things like this are wearing me down.
The vets were cool people but the prices were outrageous and I think there should be pet insurance more readily available before you get handed an estimate for almost 900 in the first exam....

Please stay far away from this clinic. I only chose it because it was close to home, but I deeply regret not listening to the negative reviews.

I brought my dog in because he has been suffering from severe skin allergies, and I wanted to make sure he received treatment before I leave for an upcoming trip. After making us wait, the vet (didn’t catch her name but she’s a middle aged white lady) entered the room with an immediately rude and condescending tone. She saw in his records that he had previously been prescribed trazodone and gabapentin for stressful visits and asked, “You gave him the dose last night and this morning, right?” No one from the clinic had instructed me to give him those medications before this appointment, and I would never medicate my dog without first confirming instructions with a veterinarian.

She then labeled him as highly aggressive and claimed he had a history of biting, which is completely false. My dog has never bitten anyone. He can be vocal when he is uncomfortable and communicates his boundaries, but she made no effort to approach him patiently, gain his trust, or even assess his behavior for herself. She appeared to make up her mind about him before she even entered the room and refused to so much as look at his skin.

Instead of attempting an examination or discussing how to help his severe itching, her only solution was to calculate a higher dose of his sedating medications based on his current weight and have me bring him back for another appointment. If sedation was required before she would even look at him, why weren’t his records reviewed beforehand? The clinic could have called me before the appointment with the appropriate instructions instead of allowing me to drive there, wait, and leave without my dog receiving any care.

I understand that veterinary staff must prioritize safety, but there is a major difference between taking reasonable precautions and refusing to even try. He was there for a skin condition, not an invasive procedure. At the very least, I expected her to attempt a visual assessment, speak to me respectfully, and discuss possible treatment options.

The lack of preparation, compassion, and professionalism was unacceptable. I came here because my dog is suffering, and now I am leaving for my trip without his condition being addressed. This visit was a complete waste of my time, and I would not trust this clinic with my pet.

I don’t usually leave reviews, but I was frustrated about my experience here. It was my first time coming here, since I recently adopted a 1.5 year old dog from a previous owner who could no longer care for her. I scheduled a check up for her and upon scheduling, I noted that she was a very reactive dog & anxious/nervous. When i came to my appointment the Vet would not see my dog without her being on calming medication. I don’t mind doing so, but it is frustrating that this issue was in my notes when I scheduled the appointment, but was not addressed until I took the day off of work for her appointment and she would not be seen. If i had known prior, I would not have minded, and I did not appreciate that I felt  the vet was rude about it and was not friendly towards me and my dog. HOWEVER, the ladies at the front/reception, and the vet tech prior to the vet coming in were SO KIND and friendly.

really nice and clean vet clinic! i needed an appt quickly to get updated rabies shots for my kitties for my new apartment rental app. they were able to schedule me within the next week and see my two kitties (only one pictured). they seemed really gentle w/ both of them and their diff temperaments and knowledgeable about the care they were providing them as patients. i will continue going here as i’ve had some nightmare vet experiences in la in the past. the DVM and techs are very friendly and knowledgeable.

cost was pretty affordable (under $200 for both, but idr), they had a full check up plus updated rabies shots. also gave me some tick&flea treatment for the both of them despite them being indoor cats.

they have a small parking lot connected to the clinic but you may have to find street parking if they’re full. all in all, 5/5!

Highly recommend staying far away from this place.  Not only do they price gouge like no other, but when I came there they sent me to a room, forgot I was there and made me wait almost an hour until I said something.  If I didnt they would have forgot about me.  Also the lady I talked to today around 2:30pm said "I dont appreciate your tone" when I said that $800 to get my two cats fixed was double the price Ive paid previously and that there place is unethical with their price gouging.

The doctor and the staff are attentive, and I felt really taken care of and listened to. I do wait a bit after being called but overall, not a big deal. I was able to get same day appointment and the staff are very friendly and professional.

I’ve been coming to Shatto Vet since getting my cat in 2020. It is one of the hardest vets office to get an appointment - and sustain an appointment. The vet is constantly “calling out sick” after appointments get confirmed the day before. Theres no way there’s only one vet available.
Stupid interaction on the phone with a technician/receptionist who has no proper phone etiquette when talking to clients. I made my appointment a week in advance this time for concerns with my cat. This kid had the audacity to tell me “sounds like you’re really worried about that” which is incredibly rude and dismissive of a comment to say towards your clients when you’re attempting to reschedule an appointment. No empathy, no care, just: “yeah maybe you can try an urgent care or another vets office”, “sounds like you’re worried about that”. This is not the first time, second, nor third that my standing confirmed appointment had to be cancelled.
Mind you, it’s tough enough as it is to find a vet in LA that’s open on the weekends. They’re constantly changing their schedules because I for sure had weekend appointments with them before.
I’ve been back and forth of coming back here over the last 6 years and still kept giving them a chance. Im officially done with this place.

I’ve been coming to Shatto 6 years now and it’s always been a great experience. Even in the middle of the pandemic they have always made me and Hermes (my cat) feel welcomed and at ease. Friendly and knowledgeable staff is what makes us come back every year. I recommend them 100%.

Thank you for the great rating, Nelsie Spencer! We're here to provide the best quality care and expertise, and are glad to see we succeeded. Our team appreciates you taking the time to leave us a review!
Yes I feel very comfortable when taking my doggy here. Pleasant atmosphere sociable n knowledgeable staff. I’m confident in their service. 2 thumbs up 👍 …
I visited for the first time today, and both the front desk staff and the doctors were incredibly friendly! They also explained everything very clearly I am very satisfied👍 …

I love bringing my fur babies to this vet ..The prizes are reasonable and thr staff is very professional and explain everything detail about whats wrong with my fur baby im glad I found them..Very good customer service the doctors and thr the front desk ..

Thank you for the rating, Carlos. We're disappointed to see you didn't have the best experience with us. If you have additional feedback or concerns, feel free to contact us at (213) 352-1252. We hope, if ever needed, you visit us again for a better experience.
Love my experience every time my dogs and I visit. They dont push unesesary treatments on you like other places.
I took my baby boy Rufus as a first time appointment, he’s very much a rowdy boy & they handled him with care & comfort, the whole team was great especially the front staff
Very friendly staff, knowledgeable veterinarians and easy to get an appointment almost the same day

Staff here were very unfriendly and rude. I went in for a routine vaccine for my cat and staff were not very attentive to me. So spent alot of time sitting and waiting. The vet tech was very nice and personable tho. She pointed out to the front desk that I was waiting and gave my cat his vaccinations quickly.
Front desk was very unprofessional especially the one with the face peircings. Unfriendly and unapologetic when taking a long time to process my payment. There were no other customers waiting. No smile no customer service so felt uncomfortable. Just a very weird interaction overall. Won't be coming here again.

I scheduled an appointment for my cat end of January to which I got a call a few hours before the time of my appointment from this vet that they will need to reschedule due to the doctor leaving early. I tried to call them back to reschedule but got no answer even after leaving a voicemail no call back. I then rescheduled on their website for the earliest appointment which was end of February to which again, same day, got a call from this vet that the Dr is leaving early and I will need to reschedule. I called and left a voicemail, waited 24-48 business hours with no response. Called again and was told I had to wait another month for another appointment. How this place is operational is beyond me.

Needed to bring my cat due to an emergency Called and phone went to voicemail but I couldn’t leave a voicemail . I arrived during operation hours (before the lunch time closure ) and there was no one here. Not sure why.
